title: Fuel Price Hike (PMS Scarcity)
description: Fuel queues stretch 2 kilometers down the expressway. Black market fuel jumps to ₦1,400/litre. Your generator and transport costs will triple this week.

choices.text: Buy black market fuel to keep the shop running fully (-₦25,000)
choices.outcomeMessage: Your lights stayed on while neighboring shops were dark! Customers appreciated your reliability.
choices.moneyLesson: Energy resilience is a core business expense in Nigeria. Upgrading to solar eliminates recurring fuel gouging.

choices.text: Close early at 4 PM to save fuel (Zero extra cost, lost walk-ins)
choices.outcomeMessage: You saved on fuel costs, but several evening regular customers found your doors locked.
choices.moneyLesson: Cutting operational hours preserves capital during supply shocks, but risks losing long-term customer habits.

choices.text: Raise product/service prices temporarily by 20%
choices.outcomeMessage: Margins stayed healthy, but customers grumbled loudly about inflation.
choices.moneyLesson: Passing inflation directly to consumers must be balanced with perceived value and competitor pricing.

title: National Grid Breakdown
description: Total blackout across the entire metropolis. Heat is suffocating and local businesses without generators are completely paralyzed.

choices.text: Rent a neighbor's heavy generator for 3 days (-₦18,000)
choices.outcomeMessage: A flood of stranded customers entered your cool, well-lit shop!
choices.moneyLesson: Investing in continuity turns community-wide downtime into market share acquisition.

choices.text: Manage with rechargeable lamps and hand fans
choices.outcomeMessage: Heat exhausted you and customers left quickly without browsing.
choices.moneyLesson: Customer comfort directly influences shopping dwell time and basket size.

title: Mama Nkechi Wants Credit ('Book am for me')
description: A familiar neighborhood auntie bought goods worth ₦30,000 and promises: 'My husband will pay when salary enters at month end.'

choices.text: Give her credit to preserve good neighborhood relations
choices.outcomeMessage: She showered you with blessings, but your working cash is now tied down.
choices.moneyLesson: Uncollected receivables are the #1 killer of small retail. Sales on credit do not pay your wholesalers.

choices.text: Politely ask for 50% deposit now (-₦15,000 goods, +₦15,000 cash)
choices.outcomeMessage: She agreed reluctantly and paid half. Your working capital is somewhat protected.
choices.moneyLesson: Partial down-payments filter out bad debts and cover your wholesale cost of goods.

choices.text: Firmly decline: 'Strict Cash & Transfer Only, Ma'
choices.outcomeMessage: She frowned and walked away, but your inventory remained 100% intact.
choices.moneyLesson: Setting clear payment boundaries protects your survival. No profit is realized until cash is received.

title: Sudden Malaria & Typhoid Episode
description: High fever, chills, and physical exhaustion hit you on Tuesday morning. You need hospital tests and drips immediately.

choices.text: Pay from Personal Savings / Emergency Fund (-₦25,000 savings)
choices.outcomeMessage: Your dedicated emergency fund saved the day! Your business operations were untouched.
choices.moneyLesson: An emergency fund acts as an emotional and financial shock absorber, isolating your business from personal crises.

choices.text: Raid the shop cash drawer to pay the hospital bill (-₦30,000 biz cash)
choices.outcomeMessage: You recovered, but now your shop has less capital to restock this weekend.
choices.moneyLesson: Mixing business and personal money erodes trading capital. When you 'eat your seed', you compromise future harvests.

choices.text: Buy cheap over-the-counter paracetamol & self-medicate (-₦4,000 personal)
choices.outcomeMessage: You stayed sick all week, moving slowly and missing customer orders.
choices.moneyLesson: Failing to invest in health creates expensive productivity drops. Health is your primary human asset.

title: 'Urgent ₦20k' Village Support Request
description: Your uncle calls explaining that your younger cousin's school registration deadline is this Friday. He expects you to send money.

choices.text: Send the full ₦20,000 from Personal Wallet (-₦20,000)
choices.outcomeMessage: Your family sent heartfelt prayers and praised your generosity.
choices.moneyLesson: Black tax is a social reality, but must be budgeted as a planned monthly line-item, not impulsive withdrawals.

choices.text: Send a token of ₦8,000 with honest explanation (-₦8,000)
choices.outcomeMessage: They appreciated the effort and managed the shortfall elsewhere.
choices.moneyLesson: Healthy boundaries prevent financial over-extension while maintaining family goodwill.

choices.text: Explain that funds are tied up in business stock (₦0)
choices.outcomeMessage: Cold silence on the phone. You feel guilty, but your capital stayed intact.
choices.moneyLesson: You cannot pour from an empty cup. Growing the business today enables sustainable generosity tomorrow.

title: Alaba Market Bulk Clearance Discount
description: Your main importer needs rapid liquidity to clear customs. He is offering a 35% flash discount on high-demand stock if paid upfront in cash.

choices.text: Spend ₦60,000 to buy 25 discounted units (-₦60,000 cash, +25 stock)
choices.outcomeMessage: Incredible deal! Your unit cost dropped significantly, giving higher gross margin.
choices.moneyLesson: Liquidity allows you to seize bargain opportunities. Cash reserves give you pricing leverage over suppliers.

choices.text: Buy modest batch of 10 units for ₦25,000 (-₦25,000, +10 stock)
choices.outcomeMessage: Safe and balanced purchase without draining your bank balance.
choices.moneyLesson: Disciplined inventory management avoids tying up all working capital in single bets.

choices.text: Pass on the deal and conserve cash liquidity (₦0)
choices.outcomeMessage: You kept total cash liquidity, although competitors scooped up the discounted stock.
choices.moneyLesson: Passing on discounts is acceptable if your cash runway is currently tight.

title: Landlord Gives Sudden Rent Hike Notice
description: Your shop landlord presents a letter announcing a 25% rent increase due to neighborhood property developments and inflation.

choices.text: Negotiate hard: offer 6 months upfront payment for a modest 10% hike
choices.outcomeMessage: The landlord accepted the upfront payment! Your long-term rent rate is locked in.
choices.moneyLesson: Landlords value guaranteed cashflow over empty promises. Leverage advance payments for rental discounts.

choices.text: Accept the 25% hike and adjust weekly personal budget
choices.outcomeMessage: Your living margin tightens, increasing weekly pressure.
choices.moneyLesson: Rising fixed overhead forces you to either grow top-line revenue or trim discretionary lifestyle spending.

title: Market Day Bonanza & Festive Rush
description: The neighborhood is bursting with holiday shoppers, wedding parties, and end-of-month paychecks! Foot traffic is quadruple normal levels.

choices.text: Open early at 7 AM, stay till 10 PM & run combo deals (+₦45,000 profit)
choices.outcomeMessage: Massive sales volume! Your cash register rang non-stop, though you are exhausted.
choices.moneyLesson: Capitalize aggressively during seasonal demand peaks to build cushions for dry seasons.

choices.text: Trade at normal hours with steady standard pricing (+₦20,000 profit)
choices.outcomeMessage: Pleasant, steady sales with zero burnout.
choices.moneyLesson: Balancing profit maximization against human physical limits prevents costly burnout.

title: Staple Food & Transport Inflation Spike
description: Headline inflation jumps this month. Rice, cooking gas, and public transport fares leap by 18% across town.

choices.text: Buy a 50kg bag of rice and cooking staples in bulk now (-₦35,000 personal)
choices.outcomeMessage: Bulk purchasing shielded your household from future price spikes for months!
choices.moneyLesson: Hedging inflation by converting depreciating fiat cash into durable non-perishable consumables is sound economics.

choices.text: Cut back luxury dining, cook simple meals, and use bus instead of taxis
choices.outcomeMessage: Your spending stayed flat, but frugal living requires mental discipline.
choices.moneyLesson: When inflation erodes purchasing power, lifestyle adjustments protect your savings rate.

title: Midnight Burglar Scare in the Plaza
description: Thieves attempted to cut open roof locks in your shopping complex. The landlord recommends contributing to joint night guard security.

choices.text: Install reinforced iron burglary proofing & pay guard dues (-₦28,000 biz)
choices.outcomeMessage: Your shop is now impenetrable. You sleep soundly at night knowing your goods are safe.
choices.moneyLesson: Physical security and loss-prevention measures are fundamental capital protection.

choices.text: Rely on existing padlock and pray for the best (₦0)
choices.outcomeMessage: Nothing happened this week, but persistent anxiety wakes you up at 3 AM.
choices.moneyLesson: Saving money by skipping basic insurance or security leaves you vulnerable to total ruin.

title: Viral Instagram / TikTok Food & Goods Review
description: A popular lifestyle creator posted a glowing video about your business: 'Best customer service and genuine items in the area!'

choices.text: Spend ₦20,000 on customer giveaways & branded packaging (-₦20,000, +25 Rep)
choices.outcomeMessage: Your shop went viral! New customers flooded in and became regulars.
choices.moneyLesson: Turn organic viral attention into sustained retention with remarkable hospitality and brand trust.

choices.text: Politely thank the creator and welcome walk-ins naturally (+₦15,000 sales)
choices.outcomeMessage: Pleasant bump in sales without incurring additional advertising expenses.
choices.moneyLesson: Word of mouth is the highest-ROI marketing channel in consumer business.

title: Fast Loan App SMS Temptation
description: 'INSTANT APPROVAL! Get ₦150,000 into your account in 3 minutes! No collateral required!' The fine print states 15% interest every 2 weeks.

choices.text: Delete message immediately. Avoid predatory loan shark rates (₦0)
choices.outcomeMessage: You wisely avoided a vicious cycle of defamatory debt recovery messages.
choices.moneyLesson: Predatory consumer loans with 15-30% monthly compounding interest will destroy business economics.

choices.text: Accept ₦100,000 loan to rapidly expand stock (+₦100k cash, +₦130k debt)
choices.outcomeMessage: Cash in hand! But now you owe ₦130,000 due in short order, with harsh penalties.
choices.moneyLesson: Borrow only when your return on capital is strictly higher than the borrowing cost.

title: WhatsApp 'Double Your Money' Forex Syndicate
description: A church acquaintance pitches an exclusive 'Offshore Forex Arbitrage Fund' promising guaranteed 40% returns every 7 days. Everyone in the group is hyping it.

choices.text: Politely decline and warn others: 'If it sounds too good to be true, it is.'
choices.outcomeMessage: Three weeks later, the admins deleted the group and disappeared with members' money! You saved your hard-earned funds.
choices.moneyLesson: No genuine investment can promise astronomical guaranteed weekly returns without catastrophic risk. Protect your principal.

choices.text: Invest ₦50,000 personal savings to test the waters (-₦50,000 personal)
choices.outcomeMessage: The platform vanished! The website shows Error 404. Your ₦50,000 is gone forever.
choices.moneyLesson: Greed blinds investors to due diligence. Compound wealth slowly through legitimate, productive assets.

title: Local Government Council 'Task Force' Visit
description: Men in official green vests arrive demanding payment for 'Trade Sanitation, Radio Permit & Business Premises Levy'. They threaten to lock the shop.

choices.text: Demand official treasury receipt and pay verified sum (-₦15,000 biz)
choices.outcomeMessage: You obtained an official council sticker. They won't harass you again this quarter.
choices.moneyLesson: Insisting on stamped receipts establishes official compliance and stops repeat extortion.

choices.text: Bribe them with ₦6,000 cash quietly behind the door (-₦6,000 biz)
choices.outcomeMessage: They left for today, but noted you as an easy target for future informal shakedowns.
choices.moneyLesson: Shortcuts may seem cheaper today, but official paper trails defend your business long-term.

title: Customer Left Valuable Item in Shop
description: While sweeping your shop floor at closing, you find an expensive smartphone and ₦40,000 cash forgotten on the counter.

choices.text: Safekeep it and return it to the frantic customer tomorrow morning
choices.outcomeMessage: The overwhelmed customer cried tears of joy, rewarded you with ₦10,000, and recommended you to all colleagues!
choices.moneyLesson: Integrity is the supreme currency in business. A stellar reputation attracts lifelong customers and credit.

choices.text: Quietly pocket the ₦40,000 cash for personal expenses (+₦40,000 personal)
choices.outcomeMessage: Word leaked that an item went missing at your premises. Rumors hurt your walk-in traffic.
choices.moneyLesson: Dishonest gain produces lingering guilt and toxic reputation destruction that outlasts the quick cash.

title: Torrential Rainy Season Deluge
description: Gutters overflow as 4 hours of torrential downpour turns the market road into a flowing river. Water is lapping at your shop threshold.

choices.text: Hire boys immediately to stack sandbags and elevate stock (-₦12,000 biz)
choices.outcomeMessage: Your inventory was kept high and dry! Next-door shops suffered damaged goods.
choices.moneyLesson: Small proactive expenditures in disaster preparedness save massive capital losses.

choices.text: Wait for rain to stop and pray water doesn't cross the door
choices.outcomeMessage: Water seeped into the bottom shelf, spoiling several packages.
choices.moneyLesson: Hope is not a risk management strategy. Always elevate valuable merchandise.

title: Port Congestion & FX Scarcity Delay
description: Your wholesale distributor's container is stuck at Apapa port due to foreign exchange volatility. Prices will surge next week.

choices.text: Lock in local alternative supplier contracts now (-₦15,000 biz advance)
choices.outcomeMessage: You secured supply before local shortages drove wholesale prices higher.
choices.moneyLesson: Diversifying suppliers mitigates single-point-of-failure vulnerabilities in your supply chain.

choices.text: Sell existing stock slowly without restocking until port clears
choices.outcomeMessage: You conserved cash, but ran out of key customer items by Thursday.
choices.moneyLesson: Stockouts represent missed revenue and drive loyal clients to competing shops.

title: Big Owambe Saturday Bulk Order
description: A wealthy party host needs emergency bulk supplies for a 400-guest Saturday event. They offer a 30% premium for instant delivery.

choices.text: Mobilize stock and fulfill the full order (+₦65,000 cash, -18 stock)
choices.outcomeMessage: Huge payday! The party organizers were ecstatic with your prompt delivery.
choices.moneyLesson: Special event catering and corporate orders provide high-margin cash injections.

choices.text: Fulfill half the order to retain stock for walk-in regulars (+₦32,000 cash, -8 stock)
choices.outcomeMessage: Balanced profit while keeping regular neighborhood shoppers happy.
choices.moneyLesson: Never completely starve core daily clients to chase a one-off windfall.

title: Shop Assistant Pleads for Salary Advance
description: Your reliable sales assistant begs for 2 weeks salary advance because their mother fell ill in Ondo state.

choices.text: Grant the advance with structured weekly deductions (-₦15,000 biz cash)
choices.outcomeMessage: Your assistant showed immense loyalty, working double-time with genuine enthusiasm.
choices.moneyLesson: Empathy in staff management builds irreplaceable loyalty and reduces costly employee turnover.

choices.text: Give a non-repayable gift of ₦5,000 from personal cash (-₦5,000 personal)
choices.outcomeMessage: They were deeply grateful for your support and business cash remained steady.
choices.moneyLesson: Compassionate gifts protect the business payroll schedule while offering genuine assistance.

choices.text: Strict policy: 'No salary advances permitted' (₦0)
choices.outcomeMessage: Staff felt demotivated, resulting in sluggish service and mistakes at the till.
choices.moneyLesson: A demoralized workforce directly harms sales and inventory supervision.

title: New Competitor Opens Across the Road
description: A well-funded competitor opened a glossy shop directly opposite you, slashing prices to undercut your customer base.

choices.text: Double down on customer loyalty, smiles & free bonus packaging (-₦8,000 biz)
choices.outcomeMessage: Your regular customers refused to switch! Trust defeated cheap gimmicks.
choices.moneyLesson: Compete on service and customer relationships, not suicidal price wars that eliminate profits.

choices.text: Slash prices below cost to drive them out (-₦25,000 margin hit)
choices.outcomeMessage: You sold out fast, but lost money on every carton. Your cash reserves shrank.
choices.moneyLesson: Price wars hurt small businesses worse than well-capitalized competitors. Protect your margins.

title: Neighboring Shop Fire Emergency Appeal
description: An electrical spark burnt down a fellow trader's stall down the lane. The market association organizes an emergency relief contribution.

choices.text: Contribute ₦15,000 from Personal Wallet (-₦15,000 personal)
choices.outcomeMessage: Market elders commended your community leadership and unity.
choices.moneyLesson: Social capital and community solidarity form an informal safety net in informal markets.

choices.text: Contribute ₦5,000 modest token (-₦5,000 personal)
choices.outcomeMessage: You participated honorably within your financial means.
choices.moneyLesson: Give within your means so your philanthropy does not jeopardize your own financial stability.

title: Banking App Network Glitch
description: Weekend interbank settlement failed. Three major customers made transfers of ₦45,000 that haven't hit your business account yet.

choices.text: Kindly ask customers to wait or pay cash until credit alert reflects
choices.outcomeMessage: Two paid cash; one cancelled. But you avoided fake transfer fraud!
choices.moneyLesson: Never release high-value inventory on unconfirmed payment screenshots. Value real settlement.

choices.text: Release goods based on their transfer debit alerts
choices.outcomeMessage: Two transactions cleared on Monday, but one reversed. You lost ₦15,000.
choices.moneyLesson: Debit alert on customer's phone does not equal credit alert in your bank.
